reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: § 24.1 gives Customer a consent-free affiliate/successor (M&A, asset-sale) carve-out subject only to notice and assumption of obligations, matching the preferred position.

§ 24.2 binds Vendor asymmetrically (no assignment, delegation of material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent; no assignment to a direct Customer competitor), and § 24.3 is expressly limited to 'other assignments' so it does not erode the § 24.1 carve-out.

§ 24.4 expressly negates any Vendor right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service on our change of control, so the walk-away trigger is absent; § 13.3 aligns licence transfer with a Section 24 permitted assignment.
No redline or counterparty comment is proposed, which is the correct output for a compliant finding, and the deterministic carve-out check passes.

Minor, non-disqualifying nuance: the competitor bar in § 24.2 is qualified by 'without Customer's consent' and limited to 'direct' competitors, but since consent rests with us this does not fall below the preferred position.
